description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for setting up a language model-based chatbot using LangChain, SQL database connection, and Google Generative AI, including prompt generation, SQL query extraction, data retrieval, and response generation.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a detailed prompt for SQL query generation based on user question and table info.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts SQL query enclosed within ```sql and ``` from model output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the SQL query against the database and fetches all results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Creates a comprehensive prompt for answer generation based on user question, SQL, data, and table info.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text content from GEMINI model response object.
